markers.name: Pusillin
markers.notes: Final combat location after the chase; drops the Crescent Key. Intermediate chase stops are not mapped.

markers.name: Lethtendris
markers.notes: Shared encounter with Pimgib; numbers 2 and 3 are not separate rooms or a required kill order.

markers.name: Zevrim Thornhoof
markers.notes: Kill Zevrim, then return to Old Ironbark in panel III to unlock transition D.

markers.name: Isalien
markers.notes: Optional Dungeon Set 2 summon in the same chamber as Alzzin; requires the Brazier of Beckoning. Empyrean is an encounter add, not a separate boss marker.

markers.to: I <-> III: passage down from the upper route to the lower hall.
III <-> II: ramp to the Lethtendris and Pimgib platform.
III <-> II: passage and ascent to Zevrim Thornhoof.
III <-> IV: Old Ironbark / Ironbark the Redeemed opens the Conservatory Door after Zevrim dies; then descend to Alzzin.
I -> III: one-way jump from the entrance ledge to the courtyard; skips the Pusillin chase.

The exact Felvine Shard and Isalien summoning positions are unverified; Q4 and Q5 are area markers.
